name: Manta
lore: A wide, flat hull built round a radar. Its laser burns missiles out of the air and its sixteen cells put a whole ripple of missiles up to meet aircraft. Nothing on it touches a submarine.

weapons.name: Vertical Missile Array
weapons.lore: Sixteen cells forward of the bridge, fired as one ripple. The missiles leave straight up and curve onto their marks.

weapons.name: Deck Gun
weapons.lore: One gun forward, for what comes close.
